summary: TC Energy filed a 6-K attaching an October 13, 2026 news release announcing closing of an agreement under which FN CGL Pipeline Limited Partnership, an Indigenous-led entity representing five British Columbia First Nations, acquires an economic interest in the entity holding TC Energy's limited partner interest in Coastal GasLink. No stake percentage, purchase price, or implied valuation was disclosed. RBC Capital Markets advised TC Energy; Blake, Cassels & Graydon served as legal counsel. Proceeds and retained economics are undisclosed, and a second transaction with additional First Nations is expected to close in Q4 2026. Watch for terms disclosure and any leverage or capital-allocation implications.
